title: Upgrade Oracle: scorecard-driven preflight & rollout gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a deterministic, scorecard-driven preflight system ("Upgrade Oracle") that aggregates smoke checks, perf regression gates, and eval-suite signals into a single numeric score and human-readable verdict to drive rollout policies across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. The goal is to reduce manual gate decisions, shorten release cycle time for minor and patch updates, and harden LTS promotions by applying consistent, auditable acceptance criteria.
background_and_motivation: Current release decisions require manual synthesis of multiple dashboards and adhoc runbook checks. This leads to inconsistent gating between runtime and model upgrades, slower rollouts for low-risk patches, and riskier LTS promotions. The Upgrade Oracle will formalize acceptance criteria, provide reproducible preflight runs, and expose an API for the release orchestrator to decide: auto-promote, staged canary, or block and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard pipeline runs end-to-end in CI and produces a numeric score and PASS/FAIL verdict for any runtime+model combo.
Scorecard integrates three signal groups: smoke tests, perf/regression gates, and eval suites; each group contributes configurable weights.
Rollout policy mapping exists: score >= 0.90 => auto-promote; 0.75 <= score < 0.90 => staged canary with 5%->50% ramp; score < 0.75 => block and require manual review.
All results are persisted to release dashboard with links to raw test artifacts, diffs vs baseline, and automated regression analysis.
Operators can re-run the same preflight deterministically against a pinned baseline (previous LTS) and get a human-readable diff report.
Release orchestrator can call gating API and honor verdicts for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
Playbook section for rollbacks and mitigations is linked and validated by runbook DR drills.

decision_log: 2026-03-02: Decided to use weighted score instead of strict boolean gates to reduce false positives for non-critical changes. Weight default: smoke 0.5, perf 0.3, eval 0.2.
2026-03-03: Agreed to baseline comparisons against the latest LTS artifact for any candidate that targets LTS promotion. For non-LTS minor releases baseline = previous minor.
2026-03-04: Chose bootstrap A/B for perf regression detection with 95% confidence interval and allow configurable minimum sample sizes for different request types.
2026-03-05: Decided to run smoke and perf checks in a dedicated 'validation' cluster that mirrors Dedicated capacity. Eval suites run against a smaller sample on hosted infra to reduce cost.
2026-03-06: Finalized rollout policy thresholds (>=0.90 auto, 0.75-0.90 staged, <0.75 block).
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Flaky smoke tests cause false blocks. Mitigation: invest in test hardening, retry/timeout policies, and per-test flakiness tracking.
Risk: Perf regressions triggered by noise. Mitigation: require minimum sample sizes and use bootstrap CI; allow temporary soft-fail flags for noisy infra periods.
Risk: Eval quality metrics are subjective. Mitigation: use multiple automated heuristics (consistent scoring, hallucination detection) and attach human review when score is near thresholds.

Risk: Private deployments with restricted telemetry can't produce full signals. Mitigation: fallback to smoke+local perf and require manual approval for LTS promotions on Private if signal set is incomplete.
observability_and_metrics: Primary KPIs: score (0-1), pass/fail verdict, p99 latency delta vs baseline, error rate delta, tokens/sec throughput, cost-per-token delta, eval quality delta.
Expose per-signal breakdown and confidence intervals on release dashboard.
Create alerting rules for gating infra failures (validation cluster unhealthy, runner timeouts) to avoid false negatives/positives.
implementation_notes: Score normalization: map each signal group to [0,1] using z-score normalization against baseline distributions, then apply weights.
Perf runner should replay recorded synthetic workloads (continuous-batching, long-context scenarios) and measure cold/warm KV cache behavior.
Eval runner will compute per-prompt metrics (coherence, factuality proxy, repetition, token-efficiency) and aggregate using median-aware aggregation to reduce outlier influence.
Gating API: POST /gates/evaluate with payload {candidate_version, baseline_version, signals_requested} returns {score, breakdown_url, verdict, artifacts}.
